ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels (~65%) with high-intensity (white/light grey) mottling (~35%) primarily concentrated on the right lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe displays extensive high-contrast white mottling in diffuse geometric clusters across the medial and distal surfaces. Left lobe is largely low-intensity with a thin high-intensity band along the lateral margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, obtuse V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 135 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe follows a low-profile, nearly horizontal convex curve; the right lobe exhibits a steep upward diagonal trajectory ending in a tapered distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal tip of the left lobe appears significantly more rounded or truncated compared to the sharper, more elongated tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry between the left and right ventral lobes.
